claims.summary: Jets guide asks drivers to print or add parking passes to a mobile wallet before arriving; it says parking hangtags are unavailable.
Jets guide recommends entering the stadium one hour before kickoff; this is advice, not a gate opening time.
Jets guide announces MarissaAnn Rizzitello to lead the fan-led national anthem; attendance and performance are unverified.
Jets guide lists the Tailgate Zone outside Verizon and MetLife Gates as opening at 10 a.m. local time; opening is not verified.
Jets guide announces a Green & White Flags giveaway courtesy of JetBlue while supplies last.

interpretation: Club-published game plans and recommendations only; no actual gate status, named-person attendance, or event impact is verified.
